heading: Sponsors and banners
intro: Set up sponsor campaigns and check every creative before it goes live. A banner matches the page, not the person reading it, so everyone on the same page sees the same banner.

context.title: Page context only
context.body: A banner is picked by the page’s category, tag and language. Nothing about the reader is used.

person.title: A person approves every creative
person.body: Nothing goes live until a member of staff checks it is suitable for under-18s.

text.title: Never inside the text
text.body: At most one banner below a chapter. No pop-ups, nothing full screen.

rankings.title: Sponsors don’t change rankings
rankings.body: Sponsors have no say over what we publish, rank or remove. Every sponsor contract says so.

loadFailed: We couldn’t load this part. Try again in a moment.

sponsors.heading: Sponsors
sponsors.intro: The companies and public bodies that sponsor a campaign. Their name shows on every sponsored item.
sponsors.name: Sponsor’s name
sponsors.added: Sponsor added. Logged in the audit log.

review.heading: Review queue
review.intro: Tick every check before you approve. Your name and the time go on the campaign.

checks.suitable_for_minors: Suitable for under-18s: no alcohol, gambling, tobacco, dating or anything on the “Never advertised” list
checks.alt_text_describes: Alt text describes what the image shows
checks.link_goes_to_sponsor: The link works and goes to the sponsor’s own page
checks.text_makes_sense: The text is in the campaign’s language and makes sense

review.noPicture: No picture: a “Sponsored by” line only.
review.note: Note for the sponsor (needed to send it back)
review.approved: Approved. It goes live on its start date. Logged in the audit log.
review.sentBack: Sent back with your note. It stays off until a new version is approved.
review.lawNote: Some advertising to minors is restricted by Romanian law. When you’re unsure, send it back and ask.

picture.removed: Picture removed by the moderation team. Upload another one.

blocked.heading: Never advertised
blocked.intro: No sponsor or ad may promote these, for any age. The fixed ones can never be removed.
blocked.added: Added. Logged in the audit log.
blocked.removed: Removed. Logged in the audit log.

editor.heading: Campaign
editor.intro: It goes to the review queue when you send it. It can’t go live until someone approves the creative.
editor.noSponsors: Add a sponsor on the Sponsors page first.
editor.name: Campaign name
editor.targetingHint: Nothing ticked in a row means any page.
editor.neverNote: No personal targeting. Many readers are under 18, and we don’t show profiling ads to anyone.
editor.pictureLabel: Picture (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)
editor.pictureFirstSave: Save the draft first, then add the picture.
editor.uploaded: Picture uploaded. A moderator approves it before the campaign can go live.
editor.linkHint: Links with tracking or affiliate parts (utm_, ref=, aff= and similar) are refused.
editor.discountHint: Shown as text with a copy button, never as a tracking link.
editor.datesHint: Both days included, Romanian time. A flat fee for the period, with no promised number of views.
editor.saved: Draft saved. Logged in the audit log.
editor.submitted: Sent for review. Logged in the audit log.
editor.problemsHeading: Before it can be sent for review
editor.readOnly: This campaign has ended and can’t change.
editor.inReviewNote: This campaign is waiting for review. Saving a change puts it back in draft.
editor.approvedNote: This campaign is approved. Saving a change takes it off the pages until it is approved again.
editor.ended: Campaign ended. Logged in the audit log.

problems.sponsor_archived: The sponsor is archived; pick another.
problems.ro_alt_empty: Write the alt text in Romanian.
problems.en_alt_empty: Write the alt text in English.
problems.ro_alt_too_long: The Romanian alt text is longer than 200 characters.
problems.en_alt_too_long: The English alt text is longer than 200 characters.
problems.ro_text_too_long: The Romanian text is longer than 140 characters.
problems.en_text_too_long: The English text is longer than 140 characters.
problems.link_empty: Add the link to the sponsor’s page.
problems.link_not_https: The link must start with https:// and have no user name in it.
problems.link_tracking: The link has tracking or affiliate parts. Use the plain address of the page.
problems.discount_code_bad: A discount code is 3 to 40 letters, digits or hyphens.
problems.targets_unknown_category: One of the categories doesn’t exist any more.

errors.not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can manage sponsors. Sign in again if your staff session is older than 12 hours.
errors.not_valid: Something isn’t filled in correctly. Check the fields and try again.
errors.already_listed: That is already on the list.
errors.incomplete: The campaign isn’t complete yet. Fix the points below.
errors.checks_missing: Tick every check before you approve.
errors.picture_not_checked: The picture hasn’t been approved by a moderator yet.
errors.state: The campaign has changed since you opened it. The page now shows where it stands.
errors.wrong_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
errors.too_big: The picture is larger than 5 MB.
errors.too_many: Too many uploads in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.unreachable: The picture check couldn’t be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.

report.heading: Report
report.intro: Impressions and clicks per day, counted on our server without cookies or user IDs. Totals only: nobody who saw or clicked is recorded.
report.caption: Impressions and clicks per day, newest first, with the totals in the last row
report.empty: Nothing to report yet: the campaign hasn’t started.
